name: mainline_terminal_cross_v1
scope: Fixed2x2: full versus after-initialization point-only search history, each with original role or old native terminal posterior. Retain all five original references on identical fresh per-task terminal RNG streams. All12 Stage38 geometries and all84 old paid searches are fixed; Stage39 native shortlists are reused without posterior recomputation.
freeze: Prepare all108 physical-policy ordered shortlists and incumbent positions before new verification. Keep source models, representations, initial raw, search trajectories, terminal eligibility/ranking rules, safety80/128/128 and paired8+8 objective guard unchanged. No prior/threshold/budget/precision or task selection.
verification: Use the existing verify_frozen_shortlist and terminal_equal.verify unchanged. Seed2026101801..1812 is common across all9 cells within each task; position-specific safety RNG and paired objective RNG retain their original tags. Each arm pays its independently executed samples even when CRN yields identical raw. Never splice old verifier outcomes into a changed shortlist or new stream.
preflight: Replay the shared verifier adapter against all84 original cases from saved paid raw, checking deployment, branch and full certificate/guard fields. This tests adapter equivalence, not a new model or certificate claim.
truth_barrier: Score only after all108 registered verifiers finish. Reuse existing cached truth; unknown values stay unknown. No additional analytic truth evaluations or search-model update from verification.
primary_comparisons: Within each fixed history: native minus original terminal, separating certified quality gain from certification contribution.
Within each terminal backend: full minus after-init search history.
Interaction: (full-native minus after-init-native) minus (full-role minus after-init-role).
references: All five reference cells use the same new terminal seeds, retaining their original search histories and terminal backends.
statistical_unit: One paired task geometry with its frozen search histories;12 equal-weight task units. Report paired W/T/L with1e-12 tie tolerance, not policy/query/replication counts as independent tasks.
interpretation: Conditional terminal validation on already-opened geometries and fixed searches. Fresh verification streams are independent of search and previous verification, not fresh task confirmation. Native-terminal full-minus-control is a fixed-terminal trajectory comparison, not automatic proof of improved unsampled prediction.
cost_accounting: Retain every failed attempt and paid raw; do not restart a partially paid case. Source-stage120initial+216search physical calls are reused and reported separately, never charged as new. Stage38/39 previous verification and diagnostic costs remain separate.
